adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a reusable UI component `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx` that otherwise uses `useLocale()`/`t(...)` for labels (e.g., `t("add_another")`), but includes a hardcoded English tooltip string: `<Tooltip content="Remove email">` in the `addOnSuffix` (around the mapped EmailField). Since this component is exported from `@calcom/ui` (`packages/ui/index.tsx`), the literal makes that UI text untranslatable for all consumers. This is a real, diff-grounded i18n issue but not a functional correctness defect.
